November 6, 2026
Orchard Gate Owners Association
Attn: Board Treasurer
c/o Orchard Gate Clubhouse, 22 Orchard Gate Way, Anytown, WA 00000
Re: Clubhouse renovation, job S-2598. Balance $47,785.00
Our records show $47,785.00 past due: INV-3342 of June 30, 2026, $28,880.00 (123 days); INV-3356 of July 31, 2026, $18,905.00 (92 days).
On September 15 we were told payment would follow by September 30. We have not received it, and our reminders since then have not been answered.
Please pay $47,785.00 by November 13, 2026, or call us before then to agree a payment date in writing. Until the account is brought current it is on credit hold.
Retainage of $21,350.00 on this contract is not part of this balance; it will be billed when the contract's conditions for release are met.
Controller, HANGS Construction Services LLC
